items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I mean we still play Mozart, Brahms and Beethoven along with Philip Glass

ctx.x: Yeah that was pre-CD, that was still LPs and cassettes and all that stuff. You know I still get a lot of negative comments about what I’m doing. And I don’t have any problem with music or jazz going as far as you want it to go, but not to just abandon or throw out some of the early styles. I mean we still play Mozart, Brahms and Beethoven along with Philip Glass and who everyone else say is contemporary, I don’t know, I don’t keep up with everybody just for a name. And they all should survive. But not to say well…
Is there — how do I put this? Is that music art to you?
